parameters.name: ConnectionStringPrefix
parameters.description:
The prefix of the new endpoint. The prefix must meet the following requirements:

- Consist of lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

- Start with a letter and end with a digit or a letter.

- Be 6 to 40 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBEndpointId
parameters.description:
The endpoint ID.

> For more information, see [DescribeDBClusterEndpoints](~~98205~~).

parameters.name: NetType
parameters.description: The network type of the new endpoint. Set the value to **Public**.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECS security group.

parameters.name: VPCId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).
